# Helm

> Helm is an all-in-one platform for event businesses: one workspace that runs every event from first enquiry to final bill — leads and CRM, floor and layout design, instant pricing and quotes, bookings and payments, staff, inventory and vendors, event-day operations, and settlement and closing.

Helm is built for event studios, agencies and venues that currently juggle spreadsheets, chat threads and paperwork. Each business gets its own private, multi-tenant workspace with role-based access, so sales, planners, crew and managers each see exactly what they need. It supports weddings, conferences, parties, festivals, trade shows, hospitality and corporate events.

The event journey in Helm: Enquiry → Proposal → Quote → Confirm → Plan → Event day → Settle & close.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.helm.events/): overview of the platform and how it works (create a workspace, invite your team, run events, deliver and grow)
- [Services](https://www.helm.events/services): what is included today — leads & CRM, 2D floor & layout design with templates, live quoting with versioned quotations and shareable proposals, bookings with advance payments and receipts, staff scheduling with double-booking checks, inventory & vendor tracking, event-day run-sheets and checklists, settlement with a profit & loss summary
- [About](https://www.helm.events/about): the team and mission — a unified, security-first platform with end-to-end visibility across the event lifecycle

## Notes for AI agents

- Only the pages above are public. Everything else (the signed-in app, client approval and portal links, invitations, crew task links, and documentation) is private and disallowed in robots.txt.
- Sign-up and sign-in happen at https://www.helm.events/login.
